metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the sheet, the memo, the dinner, and a night page that stops at the breath.

yesterday: The opening is "This royall throne of Kings, this sceptred Ile." The turn is the land leased out, "bound in with shame," and the inkie blots and rotten parchment bonds.
The memo says: Leased out. That's the Burbages' word. Keep it.
She said it was no comedy. You said you are the one, in the second act. The loaf is still a finger and a half short. Three pence was the board.
October is why you walked it.
